_comment: Floating-point tolerances of the correctness oracle, read by the Rust crate (everygraph-oracle, compare.rs) and by the Python references (compare.py). A value a passes against a reference b when |a - b| <= abs + abs_over_n / n + rel * |b|. The reasoning for each number is in oracle/README.md, section Tolerances. Integer results, labels and partitions are always compared exactly; results across configurations of the same kernel are compared bit for bit (DESIGN D14).
